citations.quote: Whatever the techniques adopted, the analytical focus of credit analysis is on debt-paying ability.
The cash flow statement describes the cash generation in a business, and reformulation highlights the cash flows that are important to analysis.
Thus the analysis begins with a reformulation of the statements, following the templates of Chapter 8, to distinguish operating activities from financing activities.
Companies must disclose the factors used to identify reportable segments and the types of products and services sold by each reportable segment.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Framing the FRA toolkit application by analyst question: equity-valuation input construction (sustainable earnings, FCF, ROE), credit assessment (solvency + cash-flow coverage), M&A screening (full ratio battery + quality flags), and segment analysis. Discipline is auditable selection of tools per question with explicit assumptions.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Financial Statement Applications
